title: Night visitors in the twins' childhood home

tellings.quote: We used to have these things happen at night in our house where we'd be sleeping in bed. We both shared the same room and we'd wake up in the night and there'd be something pulling the covers off our beds.

plain: In the 1950s, in their family home near Allentown, Pennsylvania, twin brothers Jim Weiner and Jack Weiner, who shared a bedroom, would wake at night to find 'something pulling the covers off our beds.' Jim Weiner tells Michels this from his own childhood, as one of the strange night-time events he says happened in that house.
